AI Overview
Spalon - Professional Beauty Parlour (ladies & Kids) is a highly-rated, women-owned beauty salon located in Kumarapuram, Thiruvananthapuram. It is well-regarded locally for offering professional beauty services specifically tailored for women and young children. 
Overview & Key Details
Location: First Floor, Capital Tower, Medical College Kumarapuram Road, Kumarapuram, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala 695011
Contact Number: +91 83049 84911
Operating Hours: Monday to Sunday, 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM
Rating: 4.4 out of 5 stars based on 157 user reviews. 
Services Offered
The salon provides a wide array of customized treatments, which include:
Hair & Styling: Professional haircuts (highly praised for toddlers and kids), hair styling, and specialized treatments like hair spas.
Makeup & Events: Event makeup and reliable, long-lasting saree draping services.
Skincare & Grooming: Facials, manicures, pedicures, and standard waxing. 
Amenities & Planning
Amnities: Offers free Wi-Fi and restroom facilities.
Kid-Friendly: Explicitly noted as a great option for children's haircuts.
Booking: Appointments are highly recommended or required to ensure timely service.
Payment Methods: Accepts Google Pay, debit cards, and NFC mobile payments.
